# M0-k-04 — the check's minor notes (for the hardening milestone M4; none of them fails the item)

These notes come from the independent check of M0-k-04 (lane `check/M0-k-04`, 2026-10-06). The verdict and the
blockers B-1 to B-4 are in `checks/M0-k-04.md`. The rows below are minor under J180: each fails safely or lies off
the item's stated promises. Each row names its handling.

| id | observation | suggested handling | milestone |
|---|---|---|---|
| N-1 | **KI-1 was M0-a-14's index-freshness filter (N-49), not removeEdges and not the index.** Before the fix, every L3 removal in the insertChain primitive was refused (probe P3: 869/869; L1 and L2: 0 refused), so remove ∘ insert was never judged at L3. On M0-a-14-fix-s1's `batch.ts` the probe gives 0 refusals and the 10⁴ run notes {} with 0 invalid. C-0227 (3)'s "no case's batch materialises a coarser record" does not hold for the primitive's own arena: the face ring sits at L1 only, so an L3 chain materialises an L2 record. It only mattered while N-49 stood. | Amend C-0227 (3), (4) and (14)'s wording in B-2's choices row. Count judged remove ∘ insert per level in the report, so that a level judged 0 times is visible. | M4 |
| N-2 | KI-2 (`limit/cap-move-halvings`, the case data puts p exactly minEdge from q, inside attractCm) stands and is M0-k-02's. The runner's own fixture (30 cm, 8 halvings, a no-op) holds §3.11's cap. | M0-k-02 moves p beyond attractCm. Then drop KI-2. | M4 |
| N-3 | The known-pattern check (`runConstructiveOnKernel`) reads `r.failures`, which `runConstructive` caps at 20. At the nightly 100 draws a case, a known case failing past draw 20 for another reason is still counted as known. | Count the failures by pattern inside the judge, or lift the cap for a single case. | M4 |

## Closing check (lane `check/M0-k-04-close-r1`, 2026-10-06): new minor notes

These come from the closing check after fix round 1. Each is a further hardening test or a deliberate-writer escape on
a judge whose code is right today. None of them fails the item (J202 / N-45). The mutants ran in this seat's own mirrors
(`~/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-k-04/close-r1/`). Each survived the near set (8 files) and the related set
(PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000, 52 files, 1197/1197 with all five applied together).

| id | observation | suggested handling | milestone |
|---|---|---|---|
| N-15 | Mutant T9 survives. It records the constructive judge's `splitParent` AFTER the split, as the union of the two children's rings, which is the old identity of B-1. No test notices, for two reasons. The constructive "a child shrunk behind the split" control is caught by the whole-arena sweep (index-freshness) before `children-tile-parent` is read. The unrelated-face control swaps the step's value after `stepSplit` has already recorded the parent. The code itself is right: the parent is read before the split (`constructive.ts` l. 354). Probe Q2 found the swapped or duplicated children red on every committed split (12 of 12 over the first ten draws of the two cases). The remaining draws (`geom/cut-ends-at-vertex` seeds 4–9, `limit/every-rung` seeds 2 and 9) are §3.6 (2) graze pre-emptions with no split to judge. The primitive's half is pinned: T6, the same weakening in `primitives.ts`, is killed. | Add a constructive control that changes the arena after the split in a sweep-valid way, for example a small closed ring inserted in one child by a real transaction. A pre-split parent catches that change. A post-split capture cannot. | M4 |
| N-16 | Mutant B3g survives. It makes a whole run's exit ignore `report.pass` (`only === undefined ? true : …`). The planted-report exit controls in `entry.test.ts` use `--primitive obb` only. The whole toy run asserts `code === (s.pass ? 0 : 1)` with `s.pass` true. `countsReport.pass` itself is pinned (B3a–B3d killed). This extends N-5. | Add a whole toy run with the planted `runFuzz` (one crash) that expects exit 1. | M4 |
| N-17 | Mutant K07b survives. It drops the `E_BELOW_MIN_ANGLE` term from "a mandatory chain rejected for precision". The judges.test control plants `E_BELOW_MIN_EDGE` only. The judge as a whole is pinned (K07 killed). | Plant `E_BELOW_MIN_ANGLE` as well. | M4 |
| N-18 | Mutant K15b survives. It drops insetRing's collapsed-branch monotone check: `E_DEGENERATE` at the smaller distance while the larger one is ok. The judges.test plant's regex accepts either branch, and the ok-branch area check (K15, killed) carries the count. | Plant a collapse at d1 with an ok d2, and assert the "collapsed but … did not" reason. | M4 |
| N-19 | Mutant K42w survives. It drops "the refused warp changed the arena". The refused-batch-that-writes controls cover insertChain, splitFace and corridorUnion only. | Add warp to that `it.each`. | M4 |
| N-20 | Mutant T4 (the landing bound × 10) is killed only by the bound's printed value in the 1 m control's message. In behaviour, the 1 m control holds the factor below about 35×. Probe Q1 (3 000 inputs, 1 059 splits) supports the bound's premise: every joint-boundary vertex that is not a parent vertex lies within 0.62 cm of the parent's boundary (at most √2/2 cm, the hot pixel), on 1 628 such vertices. | Add a control just past the bound (for example a landing moved 2 cm on a long edge). | M4 |
